titre: Agentic Search for Counterfactual Recourse under Fixed LLM Budgets
resume: arXiv:2606.08696v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Counterfactual recourse aims to provide actionable feature changes that would alter an unfavorable decision made by a predictive model. In practice, affected individuals often benefit from multiple feasible alternatives rather than a single optimal explanation. A natural way to produce such alternatives is to prompt large language models (LLMs).
